name: @mpd-dsh/mpd
description: my-power-dsh: a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle (@mpd-dsh/mpd) carrying the specialist roster and the model-chain vocabulary on DSH-native plumbing (upstream baseline: oh-my-openagent 8c57e46, pinned)

scripts.test:qa: for f in skills/dsh-qa/scripts/*.mjs; do echo "[test:qa] $f"; bun "$f" --self-test || { echo "[test:qa] FAILED: $f"; exit 1; }; done; bun scripts/mpd-ext.mjs --self-test || { echo "[test:qa] FAILED: scripts/mpd-ext.mjs --self-test"; exit 1; }; bun scripts/mpd-ext.mjs validate extensions/mpd-ext-example || { echo "[test:qa] FAILED: scripts/mpd-ext.mjs validate extensions/mpd-ext-example"; exit 1; }; echo "[test:qa] all self-tests passed"
scripts.test:qa:strict: for f in skills/dsh-qa/scripts/*.mjs; do echo "[test:qa:strict] $f"; bun "$f" --self-test --no-skip || { echo "[test:qa:strict] FAILED: $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo "[test:qa:strict] all self-tests passed with no skips"
scripts.test:qa:all: for c in agent-teams-adopt agent-teams-dispatch agent-teams-sidebar bundle-lifecycle codegraph-smoke dual-track-smoke extension-isolation extension-lifecycle extension-mcp-bridge mcp-call memory-smoke mount-assert plan-c-smoke preset-conformance preset-register relocate-smoke session-start-team skill-catalog-probe software-smoke team-route-rewire tool-output-validation ultrawork-smoke vision-smoke web-client-adapt web-settings-bridge workmate-library workmate-team-member; do echo "[test:qa:all] $c"; bun "skills/dsh-qa/scripts/$c.mjs" --no-skip || { echo "[test:qa:all] FAILED: $c"; exit 1; }; done; bun scripts/mpd-ext.mjs --self-test || { echo "[test:qa:all] FAILED: scripts/mpd-ext.mjs --self-test"; exit 1; }; bun scripts/mpd-ext.mjs validate extensions/mpd-ext-example || { echo "[test:qa:all] FAILED: scripts/mpd-ext.mjs validate extensions/mpd-ext-example"; exit 1; }; echo "[test:qa:all] real-lane subset passed (real headless boot and/or live provider)"
